# ChemCost

> ChemCost ("Can Agents Price a Reaction? Evaluating LLMs on Chemical Cost Reasoning", NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track) is a judge-free benchmark for LLM agents on chemical reaction procurement-cost estimation. Given a reaction as it was run in the lab (component names and amounts, product, isolated mass), an agent must return the US-dollar cost of buying enough material to run the reaction at 1 mmol of a named scale reference compound, per gram of product. Labels are computed deterministically from a frozen snapshot of pack-level supplier quotes, so scoring needs no LLM judge.

- 1,427 reactions: 1,359 single-step reactions and 68 multi-step synthesis routes
- Frozen 2026 snapshot of pack-level supplier quotes, shipped with the dataset as SQLite
- Agents must resolve chemical names to structures, derive stoichiometry from lab amounts, retrieve supplier quotes, choose whole packs (purity >= 95%), and aggregate cost
- Headline metric: CTA@k, the share of reactions priced within k% of the label (CTA@10, CTA@25); abstentions count as failures
- Agent tools: get_supplier_quotes(smiles_or_name), calculate(expression); also served over MCP with `chemcost mcp`
- License: code MIT; dataset and pricing database CC BY-SA 4.0

## Links

- [Paper (arXiv:2605.07251)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07251)
- [NeurIPS 2026 poster page](https://neurips.cc/virtual/2026/poster/139478)
- [Code and evaluation harness](https://github.com/HeinzVonHank/ChemCost)
- [Dataset on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/YoungerWu/ChemCost)

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/HeinzVonHank/ChemCost.git && cd ChemCost
pip install -e ".[eval]"
python scripts/download_data.py     # data/chemcost.jsonl + data/pricing_db.sqlite
python scripts/verify_labels.py     # recompute every label from the frozen DB
python scripts/run_evaluation.py --agent react --provider anthropic --model claude-sonnet-4-6 --output results/react.json
```

```python
from datasets import load_dataset
chemcost = load_dataset("YoungerWu/ChemCost", split="test")
```

Do not give raw records to the agent under test: they contain SMILES, equivalents, selected packs and the label. Use `chemcost.evaluation.evaluator.prepare_agent_input`, and evaluate without web or Hugging Face access.
